**Figure Four**, known in Japan as **Fogir Fore**[
([フォギア・フォア]{.t_nihongo_kanji lang="ja"}[,]{.t_nihongo_comma
style="display:none"} *[Fogia
Foa]{.t_nihongo_romaji}*[^[[?]{.t_nihongo_icon
style="color:#00e;font:bold 80% sans-serif;text-decoration:none;padding:0 .1em;"}](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Japanese "wikipedia:Help:Japanese"){.extiw}^]{.t_nihongo_help})]{style="font-weight: normal"},
is a [human](/wiki/Human "Human") [martial artist]{.new
title="Martial artist (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvTWFydGlhbF9hcnRpc3Q/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"}
and fisherman from the coastal village of
[Alhambra](/wiki/Alhambra "Alhambra"). Named after the [figure-four
grappling
hold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure-four_(grappling_hold) "wikipedia:Figure-four (grappling hold)"){.extiw}
and known for his mastery of [anti-cyber martial arts]{.new
title="Anti-cyber martial arts (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvQW50aS1jeWJlcl9tYXJ0aWFsX2FydHM/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"},
he became the second man who [Alita](/wiki/Alita "Alita") fell in love
with.

## [Appearance]{#Appearance .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Appearance"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Appearance"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Figure is a barrel chested young man with dark hair who wears two
ponytails, a short one grown from his fringe and a much longer one in
back, although the rest of his hair is kept shorter. Along with a
bandanna, his typical attire consists of a patterned tank top, jeans,
and high boots with studded shins. Over this he usually wears a robe.
This was the same outfit he wore in the
[Epilogue](/wiki/Battle_Angel_Alita_Epilogue "Battle Angel Alita Epilogue")
when he visited [Ketheres Elyion]{.new
title="Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="}.
After he returned to Alhambra, Figure was shown wearing a tank top and
shorts and going barefoot. While normally clean-shaven, at the end of
*Battle Angel Alita* Figure had let his facial hair grow out with slight
traces of scarring on his chin and neck. In *[Last
Order](/wiki/Last_Order "Last Order"){.mw-redirect}* he remains
clean-shaven when appearing in Alita\'s thoughts. After losing his right
forearm in a fight with [Sechs](/wiki/Sechs "Sechs"), it was replaced
with a [cybernetic](/wiki/Cybernetic "Cybernetic"){.mw-redirect}
forearm. This was destroyed when he attempted a strike against a tree
and was replaced.

An illustration by [Yukito
Kishiro](/wiki/Yukito_Kishiro "Yukito Kishiro") for the 2003 *[Ultra
Jump](/wiki/Ultra_Jump "Ultra Jump")* calendar depicts Figure as having
black hair and being
tanned.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}1[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-1)^ In
*[Gunnm: Martian
Memory](/wiki/Gunnm:_Martian_Memory "Gunnm: Martian Memory")*, he is
depicted as being light skinned and having black hair. He wears a light
yellow bandanna, green patterned sleeveless shirt, jeans, and brown
boots.

## [Personality]{#Personality .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Personality"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Personality"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Figure\'s highest personal value is freedom, which he defines as
\"taking control of the rudder of your
life\"^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}2[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-Battle_33-2)^
During his year of wandering the
[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard "Scrapyard"), he came to believe that being
alone would be the path to true freedom. This view changed however after
meeting [Alita](/wiki/Alita "Alita") and realizing how lonely she was
and how little control she had over her own life.

The mastery of the [anti-cyber martial art]{.new
title="Anti-cyber martial art (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvQW50aS1jeWJlcl9tYXJ0aWFsX2FydD9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}
[koppo]{.new title="Koppo (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"} gives
Figure a quiet confidence, pride, and unwillingness to back down from
fights. He seems to get into these by refusing to back down from the
challenges of his [cyborg](/wiki/Cyborg "Cyborg") opponents who have
tended to dismiss him because he has no cybernetic enhancements. This
also inspired him to have a goal of defeating 1,000 cyborg opponents in
combat.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}3[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-3)^

Figure has a strong sense of justice, challenging Alita to a fight when
she revealed that she was going to abandon him and
[Yolg](/wiki/Yolg "Yolg") in the desert. Although she kept defeating
him, he would not give up until he was knocked out, and even after
reviving, yelled out that she was running out on their fight even when
she was long gone. Despite this treatment, Figure values sticking by his
friends even at the risk of his own life, coming to the aid of Yolg, and
later Alita herself.

## [Relationships]{#Relationships .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Relationships"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Relationships"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

### [[Alita](/wiki/Alita "Alita")]{#Alita .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Alita"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Alita"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Alita\'s air of mystery at first intrigued Figure, and he was not afraid
to approach her despite Yolg\'s warnings. It appeared that he genuinely
wanted to get to know her better, but became frustrated by her behavior
as a member of [TUNED](/wiki/TUNED "TUNED"). She at first saved him and
Yolg by disabling their [rent-a-guns](/wiki/Rent-a-gun "Rent-a-gun"),
then by driving them away from [Factory Train 12]{.new
title="Factory Train 12 (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9UcmFpbl8xMj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}
before its reactor exploded. She then abandoned them temporarily to
continue her mission, but returned for them after being warned by
[Bigott Eizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg "Bigott Eizenburg") about a
powerful tornado that the explosion triggered.

After being dropped by the tornado in the [Boiling Metal Battalion
base](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion_base "Boiling Metal Battalion base"),
Figure tried to teach Alita a lesson by suspending her off a high-rise.
Although she later opened up to him and revealed her mission as a TUNED
agent after he shimmied down to talk to her, he angered her by taunting
her with some [corned
beef](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/corned_beef "wikipedia:corned beef"){.extiw},
causing her to kick him and catch him in time to prevent him from
falling. When the Boiling Metal ceased shelling the city and began to
advance, Alita was quickly enraged at Yolg\'s fear of fighting and was
about to
[pistol-whip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pistol-whipping "wikipedia:Pistol-whipping"){.extiw}
him when Figure intervened, questioning her bloodlust. After Alita
declared how much she loved fighting, Figure replied that he enjoyed it
himself as well, \"better than getting three meals a day\", but that he
hated wars and \"girls that fight in
them.\"^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}2[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-Battle_33-2)^
This caused Alita to pause and start to consider Figure differently.
This was further reinforced when he intervened in her fight with the
Boiling Metal by commandeering a minigun and laying down covering fire.
When Figure was apparently killed by the battalion, Alita realized how
much she cared about him and tried to attack [Colonel
Bozzle](/wiki/Colonel_Bozzle "Colonel Bozzle"){.mw-redirect} in a rage,
but he blew off her legs below the knees using her own
[rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle "TUNED rifle"). Figure again saved Alita again
by killing [Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead "Knucklehead") when he was
about to duel her, and she revealed that she liked him when she welcomed
his kiss. After the death of Yolg, the two set off for Alhambra,
persisting when they ran out of gas and water, although Figure had to
carry Alita because she could not walk. When she told him he could leave
her behind, he refused, confessing that he was free to carry the woman
he had fallen for. They were about to die in the middle of the desert
when Bigott manipulated the weather patterns and had the skies open up
and pour down water and fish on them. After arriving at Alhambra, Alita
promised to return to Figure while he waited for her, telling him not to
cheat on her.

While Figure was fishing one day, he sensed Alita\'s presence but did
not see her when turning around. Five years after Alita fused with the
[sky hook]{.new title="Sky hook (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvU2t5X2hvb2s/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"} and
formed the [Life-Tree]{.new title="Life-Tree (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvTGlmZS1UcmVlP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="}
to save [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares "Tiphares"){.mw-redirect} and the
[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard "Scrapyard"), Figure journeyed to [Ketheres
Elyion]{.new title="Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="}
where he was found by [Koyomi](/wiki/Koyomi "Koyomi"){.mw-redirect}.
When she told him that Alita was dead, he violently refused to believe
her and after encountering a senile [Desty
Nova](/wiki/Desty_Nova "Desty Nova"), demanded to know where Alita was.
Nova lead them to a chamber inside the trunk of the Life-Tree where a
giant bulb was growing. Seeing something inside the bulb, Figure broke
it and was reunited with Alita, who had been regenerated in a
[human](/wiki/Human "Human") body in the manga\'s original ending.

In *[Last Order](/wiki/Last_Order "Last Order"){.mw-redirect},* it was
shown that Figure never forgot about her and was still waiting for Alita
to return; he even announced his intention to marry Alita despite his
master [Tauro Four]{.new title="Tauro Four (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}\'s
doubts. After discovering a [TUNED
pistol](/wiki/TUNED_pistol "TUNED pistol") being sold by a caravan, he
sets off to discover what has happened to Alita.

Yolg witnessed Figure\'s fight with a cyborg who attempted to cut in
line to become a [rail
mercenary](/wiki/Rail_mercenary "Rail mercenary"), which earned his
respect and admiration. The two happened to be stationed in the same
rail car and thus got to know each other. The bond between them was
strengthened when Factory Train 12 was derailed and Yolg\'s leg was
broken, prompting Figure to come to his aid. They later searched the
Boiling Metal Battalion\'s base for food, and Figure defended Yolg from
Alita when she was about to pistol-whip him. Despite Yolg\'s betrayal
when he shielded Colonel Bozzle from being attacked by Alita, he repaid
Figure and Alita when he refused to fire on them after being turned into
a [socket soldier](/wiki/Socket_soldier "Socket soldier") and turned on
Bozzle. After sustaining fatal injuries when his explosive charge was
detonated, Yolg begged for forgiveness and died in Figure\'s arms.

**[Koppo]{.new title="Koppo (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"}**:
Figure is a skilled practitioner of an anti-cyborg [martial art]{.new
title="Martial art (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvTWFydGlhbF9hcnQ/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"}.
He is especially deadly in close quarters, where he can make use of
\"teai\" attacks that take advantage of those attacks which originate at
the elbow, making them faster than those using punches that originate at
the shoulder, such as
[Alita](/wiki/Alita "Alita")\'s.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}4[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-4)^
Figure has mastered oscillation strikes similar to the [Hertza
Haeon](/wiki/Hertza_Haeon "Hertza Haeon") that allow him to inflict
internal damage. However he has yet to master pins and
[chokeholds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/chokehold "wikipedia:chokehold"){.extiw}
to combat non-cyborg opponents. After losing his right forearm during
his fight with Sechs, it was replaced by a cybernetic forearm. Figure
has become accustomed to the replacement, but not yet fully recovered
the use of his right arm in combat and doubts that he will be able to
fully recover as a martial artist.

In spite or because of his abilities, Figure seems to have a tendency to
get into fights with cyborgs. Up to his fight with Alita, he had beaten
35 cyborgs in combat with the ultimate aim of beating a thousand because
of his techniques. These victories were also due in part to the fact
that his opponents had not been as skilled fighters and tend to
underestimate him because he had no cyborg enhancements. Alita was the
only cyborg Figure has fought who managed to defeat him. He emerged from
his other fights relatively unscathed until he fought Sechs.

**Enhanced durability**: Despite being flesh and blood, Figure is very
resilient and hardy, likely as a result of his background as a fisherman
and practice of koppo. During his fight with Alita he kept persisting in
attempting to fight her despite getting beat down again and again. He
was able to bind his arm after his forearm had been severed and drag
himself and [AR-4](/wiki/AR-4 "AR-4") into a river, surviving to be
recovered at [Farm 21](/wiki/Farm_21 "Farm 21").

## [History]{#History .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=9 "Edit section: History"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: History"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

At an early age, Figure lost both his parents and as an only child, it
is implied that he was raised by his master [Tauro Four]{.new
title="Tauro Four (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}
in [Alhambra](/wiki/Alhambra "Alhambra"). He grew up to be a fisherman
but also became a practitioner of the anti-cyborg martial art known as
[Koppo]{.new title="Koppo (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"}. As a
child, he learned from [his village](/wiki/Alhambra "Alhambra")\'s
rainmaker a song that would summon a rainstorm when played and would
practice it on a harmonica he owned or had in his family\'s possession.
As an adult, he decided to leave Alhambra and would travel for a year
throughout the Badlands and the [Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard "Scrapyard")
in order to see [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares "Tiphares"){.mw-redirect}.

However, he did not find the Scrapyard to his liking and eventually
signed up to be a [rail
mercenary](/wiki/Rail_mercenary "Rail mercenary") on [Factory Train
12]{.new title="Factory Train 12 (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9UcmFpbl8xMj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}.
During the journey he befriended [Yolg](/wiki/Yolg "Yolg"), a fellow
rail mercenary. As the train travelled through the Badlands, he heard a
harmonica playing and came across [Alita](/wiki/Alita "Alita") playing
it atop the train. Despite Yolg\'s warnings, he became intrigued by her
and boldly took the harmonica from her hands. While his efforts to play
failed, he was able to get introduced to her. Although when he noticed
Alita\'s [rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle "TUNED rifle") as being different
from the other guns given to the mercenaries, she warned him to stay
away from her. The appearance of
[Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead "Knucklehead")'s squad on
[Gabriel](/wiki/Gabriel "Gabriel"){.mw-redirect}\'s radar warned Alita
about the pending attack, which she focused on to Figure\'s puzzlement.
When the squad attacked the train and it was derailed, Figure and Yolg
were thrown from the train, although the latter\'s leg was broken.
Figure was able to save Yolg from Knucklehead himself, and was in turn
saved by Alita who used his shoulder to brace her rifle. She then threw
them both at the train to prevent their
[rent-a-gun](/wiki/Rent-a-gun "Rent-a-gun") packs from detonating. After
the nuclear reactor began to melt down, Figure thought that they were
finished as the rent-a-gun computer had been damaged by the derailment,
but he and Yolg were again rescued by Alita, who was able to hack into
and remove their packs. She took them away in a [buggy]{.new
title="Buggy (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvQnVnZ3k/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"} from the
train before the reactor exploded. That night Figure challenged Alita to
a fight after learning that she planned to leave him and Yolg in the
middle of the desert, but was soundly beaten by her. After leaving,
Alita changed her mind when she learned from [Bigott
Eizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg "Bigott Eizenburg") that a massive
tornado had been triggered by the nuclear explosion, and returned for
Figure and Yolg.

However their jeep got caught up in the tornado and wound up on the edge
of a skyscraper. Figure was able to save them, but as payback for his
treatment by Alita, suspended her from the building. He later shimmied
down to have a talk with Alita. Although the two opened up to each
other, Figure\'s taunting set Alita off and she kicked him hard, making
him lose his grip on the rope he was hanging onto. After she managed to
grab him with her legs and threatened to drop him, the
[Barjack](/wiki/Barjack "Barjack")\'s [Boiling Metal
Battalion](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion "Boiling Metal Battalion"),
which had returned to their base, attacked. Alita saved Yolg and Figure
when the building they were on was hit and collapsed. While hiding,
Figure called into question Alita\'s bloodlust and desire for battle,
making her think about her motivations. As she fought the Barjack, he
decided to help her after realizing that she was less free than he was
because she could not choose not to fight. He hijacked a Barjack vehicle
mounting a [minigun]{.new title="Minigun (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvTWluaWd1bj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}
after the rest of the battalion arrived and had pinned down Alita,
laying down enough covering fire for her to go after Colonel
[Bozzle](/wiki/Bozzle "Bozzle"), but Yolg's defection stopped her short.
The battalion then attacked Figure, apparently killing him when the
building behind him collapsed on him.

Figure however survived, emerging from the rubble that same night after
the Boiling Metal had left to attack [Factory Farm
22](/wiki/Factory_Farm_22 "Factory Farm 22"). He managed to catch up to
the battalion when it had camped for the night and was able to save
Alita from [Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead "Knucklehead") when the
latter attempted to duel with her, after which he realized that Alita
likes him. After Bozzle was killed, Figure and Alita set off to
Alhambra. Eventually they ran out of fuel for their jeep, and Figure
carried Alita on his back as her legs had been shot off below the knees
by Bozzle. Although they ran out of water and her
[TUNED](/wiki/TUNED "TUNED") body overheated, Figure refused to abandon
her, admitting that he had fallen in love with her. They were saved by a
deluge of rain and fish, a result of Bigott having manipulated the
weather patterns to save Alita. Figure and Alita eventually reached
Alhambra, where Figure returned to his previous life as a fisherman.
Alita promised to return to him when her mission of apprehending [Desty
Nova](/wiki/Desty_Nova "Desty Nova") was finished.

Figure was later shown listening to the last broadcast of [Radio
K.A.O.S.](/wiki/Radio_K.A.O.S. "Radio K.A.O.S.") while preparing a
harpoon for
fishing.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}5[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-5)^ He
also appeared in Alita\'s thoughts during her battle with
AR-2^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}6[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-6)^ and when
Bigott offered to let her go after she apprehended
Nova.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}7[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-7)^

#### [Original manga ending]{#Original_manga_ending .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=13 "Edit section: Original manga ending"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Original manga ending"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Just before she transformed herself into the [Tree of Life]{.new
title="Tree of Life (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvVHJlZV9vZl9MaWZlP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="},
Alita was able to use her Accelerator to travel to Alhambra and see him
for the last time as he prepared to fish before returning to Tiphares
and ascending to the sky hook to fuse with the docking bolt and save
[Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares "Tiphares"){.mw-redirect} and the
[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard "Scrapyard"). Figure could not see her, but
felt her presence.

src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zz48dXNlIHhsaW5rOmhyZWY9IiN3ZHMtaWNvbnMtaW5mby1zbWFsbCI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+" /></a>
<p>Alita is reunited with Figure in the <a
href="/wiki/Battle_Angel_Alita_Epilogue"
title="Battle Angel Alita Epilogue">Epilogue</a>.</p></figcaption>
</figure>

Five years later and following the construction of the [Tower of
Tiphares](/wiki/Tower_of_Tiphares "Tower of Tiphares"),
[Koyomi](/wiki/Koyomi "Koyomi"){.mw-redirect} encountered Figure in
[Ketheres Elyion]{.new title="Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="}.
She ended up buying him dinner after he beat up three
[cyborgs](/wiki/Cyborg "Cyborg") and won a large bet she had made on
him. When asked about Alita\'s death, Figure adamantly refused to
believe that she had died. Shortly after, a senile Nova was found.
Figure grabbed him and asked him about Alita, prompting him to lead them
into the trunk of the Tree of Life's and to a chamber where a large bulb
was suspended. Seeing something, Figure ripped open the bulb, from which
emerged a [human](/wiki/Human "Human") Alita, who recognized him. This
ended the original manga.

### [*Last Order*]{#Last_Order .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Last Order"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Last Order"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

### [[Starship Cult Arc](/wiki/Starship_Cult_Arc "Starship Cult Arc")]{#Starship_Cult_Arc .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Starship Cult Arc"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Starship Cult Arc"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Just before she started her infiltration of
[Melchizedek](/wiki/Melchizedek "Melchizedek") Alita noticed a photo of
him within a photo album that was tossed to Alita in her mind by
[Colonel Payne](/wiki/Colonel_Payne "Colonel Payne"), prompting her to
longingly kiss the photo. Figure was one of the many characters from
Alita\'s past shown when Melchizedek, appearing as an afterimage of
[Arthur Farrell](/wiki/Arthur_Farrell "Arthur Farrell"), reached out to
her consciousness after her ego was shattered and her Imaginos Body
dissolved following Super Nova\'s Seca attack.

### [[Alita Quest Arc](/wiki/Alita_Quest_Arc "Alita Quest Arc")]{#Alita_Quest_Arc .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Alita Quest Arc"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Alita Quest Arc"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Eleven months before the conclusion of the [Tenth Zenith of Things
Tournament](/wiki/Tenth_Zenith_of_Things_Tournament "Tenth Zenith of Things Tournament"),
Figure was in Alhambra training under the eye of his master, [Tauro
Four]{.new title="Tauro Four (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}.
After demonstrating his mastery of oscillation strikes, Tauro told him
that it was time for the next stage and proceeded to teach him pinnings
and
[chokeholds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/chokehold "wikipedia:chokehold"){.extiw}.
Figure\'s insistence that these techniques would not work on cyborgs was
brushed off as Tauro explained that not all his opponents would be
cybernetic. When they took a break, Tauro expressed his doubts about
Figure wanting to marry Alita but the latter defended Alita and
disregarded Tauro\'s statement that his parents would have been
disappointed in him. With the arrival of a trading caravan, Figure came
across a TUNED pistol that the dealer related had been taken from the
body of the \"Angel of Death\". As he was unaware of the [TUNED AR
Series 2](/wiki/TUNED_AR_Series_2 "TUNED AR Series 2"), Figure believed
this to be Alita and that night packed up to go in search of her. To his
surprise, Tauro gave him some money for the trip and told him to come
back with Alita.

style="width: 180px">

Figure\'s first clue as to Alita\'s whereabouts came when he encountered
some former [Barjack](/wiki/Barjack "Barjack") turned bandits and asked
one of them if he recognized a photo of Alita. The man recalled that a
buddy of his who had been with the [Heng](/wiki/Heng "Heng") had seen
her and the latter led Figure to the destroyed wreckage of the
[Heng](/wiki/Heng "Heng"), pointing him in the direction of [Barjack
City](/wiki/Barjack_City "Barjack City"). While traveling, Figure
eventually found [AR-4](/wiki/AR-4 "AR-4"); unaware that it was a
duplicate, he mistook it for Alita and happily greeted her with a hug.
He was concerned when AR-4 told him they had to flee as she was being
pursued by an unknown party. As they both fled into the Badlands, their
vehicle was overtaken by a figure riding the TUNED Mobile unit and their
vehicle crashed. Figure went to confront the individual, only to be
caught by surprise when it appeared to be a third version of Alita. This
one, [with a six on its forehead](/wiki/Sechs "Sechs"), would quickly
disable Figure and attack and kill AR-4. Sechs stated it was merely a
replica and mocked him as Figure began crying and mourning its death. In
a rage, Figure suddenly pounced on Sechs and landed several punches on
its torso and face; Sechs expressed surprise and decided to kill him as
well, slicing off Figure\'s right arm. Despite losing a limb and copious
amount of blood, Figure managed to apply a tourniquet to his severed arm
to stop the bleeding and escape with AR-4\'s body before losing
consciousness.^[[\[]{.cite-bracket}8[\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-8)^

## [Other appearances]{#Other_appearances .mw-headline}[[\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Other appearances"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label="edit-section-anon" data-action="edit-section" aria-label="Edit section: Other appearances"}[\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}

Figure appears in *[Gunnm: Martian
Memory](/wiki/Gunnm:_Martian_Memory "Gunnm: Martian Memory")* as a
playable character during the first part of the [TUNED Saga]{.new
title="TUNED Saga (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvVFVORURfU2FnYT9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE="}.
During this part of the game the perspective shifts to Figure\'s and
[Gally](/wiki/Gally "Gally"){.mw-redirect} takes on a secondary role as
an NPC. She becomes playable again after they part ways at [Factory Farm
22](/wiki/Factory_Farm_22 "Factory Farm 22"). Figure\'s fighting moves
include the Hertza Haeon, which uses the same button combination to
execute as Gally. At the end of the game, which occurs five years later,
he is invited to Salem by Gally for the departure of *[Leviathan I]{.new
title="Leviathan I (page does not exist)"
uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvTGV2aWF0aGFuX0k/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x"}*,
altering the circumstances of his original visit.
